{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
completed['revenue_clean'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Check if any QA orders remain (should be 6 with revenue '999999.99')
qa_orders = completed[completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
